description: This PHP script serves as an entry point for an installer component of the OrangeHRM system. It performs environment checks (PHP version compatibility), initializes dependencies via Composer autoload, configures debugging depending on environment, and handles HTTP requests through the HttpKernel class, managing responses and errors related to session storage permissions.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Manages HTTP request handling and response generation within the application's framework.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, capable of creating instances from global server variables.

methods.name: trimVersion
methods.description: Truncates a version string to a specified number of points/segments, used for version comparison.

methods.name: isInSupportedPHPRange
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version falls within the supported range specified in configuration; terminates execution if not.
